affiliations.date_precision: The institutional source states that Glueck joined the faculty in 1928; it does not give an end date or say whether the appointment changed during his OSS work.
affiliations.research_notes: Published as documented pre-OSS employment, not as the proven immediate predecessor or last civilian employer. HUC's article separately documents his OSS mapping and logistics work.

affiliations.organization_name_as_found: American School of Oriental Research in eastern Jerusalem
affiliations.date_precision: Intermittent directorship during 1932-1933, 1936-1940 and 1942-1947; the source does not define the contractual relationship.
affiliations.research_notes: The 1942-1947 directorship overlaps his documented OSS mapping and logistics work. It is therefore published as an institutional affiliation, not as an immediate employer transition.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Nelson Glueck is the archaeologist and Hebrew Union College faculty member documented doing mapping and logistics work for OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact distinctive index name is corroborated by an HUC institutional biography that explicitly records OSS work and by NARA's inventory of wartime records by and relating to Glueck.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name plus two independent institutional and official links to OSS work in Palestine and Transjordan.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources place Glueck's HUC and Jerusalem-school affiliations before and during the OSS period, but do not establish a formal recruitment date.
claims.match_notes: The Box 277 personnel file is still needed for a confirmed private-identifier linkage and exact service chronology.

claims.claim_text: Nelson Glueck joined the faculty of Hebrew Union College in 1928.
claims.evidence_excerpt: He returned to the United States in 1928, joining the faculty of HUC.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: HUC's institutional journal dates Glueck's faculty appointment to 1928 and separately identifies his wartime OSS work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name and explicit OSS linkage in HUC and NARA sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar employment; the source does not establish that HUC was the immediate predecessor or last civilian employer before OSS work.
claims.match_notes: Do not infer that the faculty appointment ended or was suspended during OSS service.

claims.claim_text: Nelson Glueck directed the American School of Oriental Research in Jerusalem during 1932-1933, 1936-1940 and 1942-1947.
claims.evidence_excerpt: director of the American School of Oriental Research in eastern Jerusalem at various periods
claims.evidence_paraphrase: HUC's institutional journal gives three periods of Glueck's Jerusalem-school directorship and separately records his OSS mapping and logistics work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, matching archaeological occupation and explicit OSS linkage.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar and wartime institutional affiliation. The 1942-1947 period overlaps OSS service, so no immediate-predecessor inference is made.
claims.match_notes: Modeled as a professional affiliation because the reviewed source does not define the contractual relationship.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The distinctive exact index name is corroborated by an HUC institutional article that explicitly records Nelson Glueck's OSS mapping and logistics work and by NARA's inventory of wartime records by and relating to him.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 277 to establish the formal OSS start date, employment or assignment status, and whether his HUC or Jerusalem-school affiliation was continued, suspended or used as cover.

research_attempts.query_text: Nelson Glueck OSS Hebrew Union College American School of Oriental Research official and institutional sources
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Discovery-only biographies and book-sales summaries were rejected as final evidence; modern pages naming institutions after Glueck did not establish his pre-OSS chronology.
research_attempts.research_notes: NARA's official Entry 210 inventory and HUC's institutional journal securely link the distinctive indexed name to OSS work and document HUC faculty employment plus the Jerusalem-school directorship. Neither establishes the immediate pre-OSS transition.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 277 for exact OSS chronology and administrative relationship.
